name: Nike Wmns Air Zoom Vomero 5 'Mystic Red'
story_html: The Nike Women’s Air Zoom Vomero 5 ‘Mystic Red’ combines a distinctively layered design with rich hues and metallic accents. The upper features scarlet open-cell mesh with synthetic leather overlays in a shiny platinum finish. A molded midfoot cage in burgundy matches the synthetic suede detailing that appears along the forefoot. The sneaker sits atop a sculpted foam midsole with Zoom Air cushioning for improved responsiveness. Underfoot, a waffle-tread rubber outsole in red and burgundy delivers superior traction.
details: Mystic Red/Metallic Platinum/Reflect Silver/Burgundy Crush/Summit White
